subject: Important: price adjustment for your hosting plan from 1 January 2027
body:
Dear Ms Müller,

due to rising energy and hardware costs we are forced to adjust our prices. From 1 January 2027 the monthly fee for your plan "Business ERP Hosting" will increase by 15% from EUR 9,800.00 to EUR 11,270.00.

The new price will be charged automatically with the January invoice. No action is required on your side.

Thank you for your understanding.

Kind regards,
CloudHost GmbH Billing Team

subject: Annual price indexation 2027
body:
Dear customer,

in accordance with section 4 of our supply agreement, prices are adjusted annually to the consumer price index. From 1 January 2027 your monthly office supplies package will cost EUR 1,242.00 instead of EUR 1,200.00 (+3.5%).

Best regards,
PaperPro GmbH

subject: Invitation: SME New Year's reception 2027
body:
Dear members,

Your IHK team

subject: Payment run postponed – SAP migration in January 2027
body:
Dear Ms Müller,

we are migrating our finance system to SAP S/4HANA in January 2027. During the migration no payments can be released. All supplier invoices due between 1 and 31 January 2027 will therefore be paid with our first payment run after go-live on 4 February 2027.

This concerns your invoice RE-2026-1187 for the December deliveries over EUR 38,000.00, due on 5 January 2027.

If your contract obliges us to pay on the original due date, please let us know in writing – we can release a manual payment for these invoices.

Thank you for your understanding.

Kind regards,
Andreas Keller
Accounts Payable, Bauer Maschinenbau AG

subject: Anpassung der Materialpreise zum 01.01.2027
body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Müller,

aufgrund der gestiegenen Notierungen für Walzstahl und Aluminium passen wir gemäß § 6 unseres Rahmenliefervertrags die Preise für Ihre monatliche Materiallieferung zum 1. Januar 2027 um 6 % an. Der monatliche Betrag steigt damit von 14.000,00 EUR auf 14.840,00 EUR (netto).

Für Rückfragen stehen wir Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Jens Petersen
Stahlhandel Nord GmbH

subject: Information about our prices for 2027
body:
Dear customers,

rising wages and licence costs unfortunately force us to adjust our service fees moderately from 1 January 2027. You will receive the new price list for your support contract in the course of December.

Thank you for your loyalty.

Best regards,
Tobias Kraus
IT-Service Kraus e.K.
